facts.fact: 基特躺着盯天花板，胸口起伏过快，身体仍在事后颤抖。
facts.anchor: I lie here staring up at the ceiling, chest rising and falling too fast, body still trembling with aftershocks.

facts.fact: 他回想索伦射精时扯掉眼罩，黑眼睛锁住他的目光不放。
facts.anchor: when he ripped the mask off just as he came, those dark eyes locked onto mine and refused to let go.

facts.fact: 索伦整个人压到他身上，贴着他皮肤含混地说他明天要在餐桌上吃早饭。
facts.anchor: His voice comes out quiet and slurred against my skin. “You’ll… have breakfast at the table tomorrow.”

facts.fact: 索伦睡着了，打起鼾，仍压在他身上。
facts.anchor: a soft, unmistakable sound starts up above me. Snoring. Soren is out cold, dead weight pressing me into the mattress.

facts.fact: 基特用尽力气蹬床翻身，终于让索伦滑出他的身体。
facts.anchor: I gather every scrap of willpower I have left, plant my feet, and roll with my whole body.

facts.fact: 索伦翻回来，一条沉重的手臂横落在基特胸口，压得他喘不过气。
facts.anchor: a heavy arm comes down across my chest like a falling tree.

facts.fact: 基特抬起索伦沉重的手和手臂，从下面滑出来，随后滚下床跪在地毯上。
facts.anchor: I carefully pick up his heavy hand, lift his thick arm just high enough to slide out from under it

facts.fact: 基特穿好衣服，把门开到刚好能挤过去，屏息慢慢关门，不让门闩发出响声。
facts.anchor: I ease one door open just wide enough to slip through, holding my breath the entire time, and pull it shut behind me
